title: Nonnegativity of the constraint satisfaction value
statement: Let $D$ be a domain and let a finite family of predicates on $D$ be given, each with a specified arity and Boolean evaluation rule. Consider an instance with a nonempty multiset of constraints, in which every declared variable occurs in some constraint, and any assignment of domain elements to the variables. The fraction of constraints satisfied by the assignment is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: Each constraint uses a predicate from the template and an ordered tuple of distinct variables
Every declared variable occurs in a constraint scope
An assignment from variables to the domain is given
